title: Representative of a matching edge
statement: Let $q,k\in\mathbb{N}$, and consider the complete $q$-partite graph whose vertices are pairs $(i,j)$ with $0\le i<q$ and $0\le j<k$. For a perfect matching in this graph and any edge of that matching, the chosen representative vertex maps to that same edge under the matching's vertex-to-edge correspondence.
hypotheses_covered: a perfect matching in the complete q-partite graph
